component.name: CardVertical
component.description: A vertical course card (image-top layout): thumbnail, optional ProgressBar under it (stack sm), then a serif title and a meta row (Inline gap md) with optional duration, Certified marker and Completed marker. Completion is derived from progress (progress >= 100 renders the full bar plus a Completed marker). Two sizes: sm (3:2 thumbnail, card-min-sm) for saved-courses carousels, lg (4:5 thumbnail, card-min-lg) for catalog grids. For compact thumbnail-left lists use CardHorizontal; for generic surfaces use Card.

when: Displaying courses in a catalog grid (size lg)
Displaying saved or started courses in a horizontal carousel (size sm)

patterns.name: catalog-grid
patterns.description: Catalog of courses in a responsive grid; each card fills its column.
patterns.tree: Box(className=grid) > [CardVertical(size=lg, title, duration), CardVertical(size=lg, title, duration, progress=40), ...]

patterns.name: saved-courses-carousel
patterns.description: Horizontally scrollable row of small cards; each card sits at its min width.

antiPatterns.scenario: Adding a completed/status flag alongside progress
antiPatterns.reason: Lifecycle is derived from data (ADR-025): progress omitted = not started, 0–99 = in progress, 100 = completed.
antiPatterns.alternative: Pass progress={100} for a finished course.

antiPatterns.scenario: Packing certification or completion text into duration, e.g. duration="12 Hours · Certified"
antiPatterns.reason: One prop per datum; the component renders markers and spacing itself.

antiPatterns.scenario: Mixing sizes or mixing CardVertical with CardHorizontal in the same row
antiPatterns.reason: Different thumbnail ratios break the row's visual rhythm.
antiPatterns.alternative: Use one size per section: sm in carousels, lg in catalog grids.

antiPatterns.scenario: Setting a color on the marker Icons directly
antiPatterns.reason: Icons inherit currentColor; the card's CSS Module sets color.icon.subtle on the marker wrapper.
antiPatterns.alternative: Leave marker colouring to the component.

purpose.sm: Saved-courses carousel: 3:2 thumbnail, min width size.card.min.sm.
purpose.lg: Catalog grid: 4:5 thumbnail, min width size.card.min.lg.

states.description: progress >= 100: full ProgressBar plus a Completed marker in the meta row.
thumbnailSrc omitted: Image renders its placeholder.
No duration, certified or completion: the meta row is not rendered.

ariaAttributes: role=article on the root, aria-labelledby → the title Heading's id (useId); role, children, title and aria-labelledby are omitted from the props type
headingLevel sets the title element (default h3) to fit the surrounding outline
